name: Anselm of Canterbury
shortBio: Father of Scholasticism and Archbishop of Canterbury who formulated the canonical Ontological Argument for the existence of God in the Proslogion.
centralQuestion: Can the reality of God be demonstrated through pure conceptual analysis as 'that than which nothing greater can be conceived'?

keyWorks.title: Proslogion
keyWorks.description: Famous treatise containing the ontological proof of God from the concept of maximal greatness.

keyWorks.title: Monologion
keyWorks.description: Theological meditation on divine attributes and faith seeking understanding.
